commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Miguel Sesma has a clear sight and sees a foul from Guido Rodriguez (Valencia).
90+4' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play. Valencia win a corner kick.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

77' Santiago Colombatto executes the resulting corner kick. Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) picks the ball up on the edge of the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot which bounces in off the crossbar. The score changes to 2:0.
77' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) steps up to send the ball in.

74' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Sesma with no other option than to blow for a foul.

59' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

59' Jose Gaya (Valencia) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Aaron Escandell is alert and denies him with a nice save. Valencia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' Ooh that was close! Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
